lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: # Issue tracker: Local Markdown

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Issues and PRDs for this repo live as markdown files in `.scratch/`.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Conventions

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - One feature per directory: `.scratch/<feature-slug>/`

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - The PRD is `.scratch/<feature-slug>/PRD.md`

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Implementation issues are `.scratch/<feature-slug>/issues/<NN>-<slug>.md`, numbered from `01`

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Triage state is recorded as a `Status:` line near the top of each issue file (see `triage-labels.md` for the role strings)

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Comments and conversation history append to the bottom of the file under a `## Comments` heading

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## When a skill says "publish to the issue tracker"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Create a new file under `.scratch/<feature-slug>/` (creating the directory if needed).

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## When a skill says "fetch the relevant ticket"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Read the file at the referenced path. The user will normally pass the path or the issue number directly.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Wayfinding operations

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Used by `/wayfinder`. The **map** is a file with one **child** file per ticket.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Map**: `.scratch/<effort>/map.md` — the Notes / Decisions-so-far / Fog body.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Child ticket**: `.scratch/<effort>/issues/NN-<slug>.md`, numbered from `01`, with the question in the body. A `Type:` line records the ticket type (`research`/`prototype`/`grilling`/`task`); a `Status:` line records `claimed`/`resolved`.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Blocking**: a `Blocked by: NN, NN` line near the top. A ticket is unblocked when every file it lists is `resolved`.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Frontier**: scan `.scratch/<effort>/issues/` for files that are open, unblocked, and unclaimed; first by number wins.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Claim**: set `Status: claimed` and save before any work.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Resolve**: append the answer under an `## Answer` heading, set `Status: resolved`, then append a context pointer (gist + link) to the map's Decisions-so-far in `map.md`.
